#!/bin/bash
# check_mount_latency.sh - time a stat() on every mount from /proc/mounts.
set -uo pipefail
CRIT="${1:-5}"
worst=0; worst_m=""; out=()
while read -r _ m fstype _; do
  case "$fstype" in proc|sysfs|tmpfs|devtmpfs|cgroup2) continue ;; esac
  # autofs indirect maps: stat() triggers a mount and measures the automounter, not NFS.
  [[ "$fstype" == autofs ]] && continue
  t=$( { /usr/bin/time -f %e stat -t "$m" >/dev/null; } 2>&1 )
  out+=("$m $t s")
  if (( $(echo "$t > $worst" | bc) )); then worst=$t; worst_m=$m; fi
done < /proc/mounts
if (( $(echo "$worst > $CRIT" | bc) )); then
  echo "MOUNT CRITICAL - $worst_m stat() took $worst s (crit $CRIT s); ${out[*]}"; exit 2
fi
echo "MOUNT OK - ${out[*]}"; exit 0
